_comment: AMD Instinct MI355X (CDNA4) single-accelerator HAT twin, backing HBM -> Infinity Cache -> L2 -> LDS(reuse SRAM) -> compute leaf (MFMA). Single-device (minimal-device convention): no fabric/multi-GPU. Sources: AMD CDNA4 whitepaper + MI355X datasheet + Chips&Cheese CDNA4 + ROCm occupancy-math MI355X blog. Reconciled from 1 authoring pass + 2 adversarial verifications.
energy_note: 5.0/6.0 pJ/B (read/write) are BRONZE estimates; AMD does not publish per-byte HBM energy. Scaled from H100 HBM3 7 pJ/B anchor by ~30% HBM3e efficiency gain. Directional only, not load-bearing.

provenance.source: AMD MI355X datasheet + CDNA4 whitepaper (288 GiB = 309,237,645,312 B; 8 TB/s HBM3e), cross-checked Chips&Cheese CDNA4 + ROCm occupancy blog + Oracle OCI brief

children.note: 256 MB memory-side last-level Infinity Cache (128 MB per IOD x 2 IODs). Capacity GOLD (whitepaper); bandwidth 1.7e13 is a BRONZE estimate (unpublished, extrapolated from MI300-gen LLC peak). Auxiliary cache annotation, NOT the primary reuse tier -> its BRONZE bandwidth is non-load-bearing for the experiment.

provenance.source: capacity: AMD CDNA4 whitepaper + ROCm blog (256 MB, GOLD); bandwidth: estimate from CDNA3/MI300 Infinity Cache order (BRONZE, disputed by both verifiers)

children.note: 32 MB total = 4 MB per XCD x 8 XCDs (16-way, writeback). Per-XCD figure from whitepaper mirror; total derived. Bandwidth 1e13 is order-of-magnitude anchor (H100-class L2), not separately published.

provenance.source: whitepaper mirror + aiwiki MI355X per-XCD 4 MB x 8 XCD; total derived (SILVER)

children.note: Primary reuse tier. LDS (Local Data Share) = 160 KB/CU x 256 CU = 40 MiB (2.5x CDNA3). Capacity GOLD (whitepaper 160 KB/CU cross-checked Chips&Cheese '40 MB total LDS'). Aggregate BW = 256 B/clk/CU x 2.4e9 Hz x 256 CU = 1.573e14 B/s, DERIVED from published 256 B/clk read -> SILVER. L1 vector cache is separately 32 KB/CU.

provenance.source: capacity GOLD (AMD 160 KB LDS/CU + Chips&Cheese 40 MB); aggregate BW derived from 256 B/clk/CU x clock (SILVER)

children.note: CDNA4 Matrix Core (MFMA). per-CU BF16 = 4096 FLOP/clk/CU -> 2048 MAC/clk x 2.4e9 = 4.9152e12 MAC/s; x256 CU x2 = 2.516e15 FLOP/s ~ 2.5 PFLOPS dense BF16 (datasheet GOLD). Device peaks (GOLD, whitepaper): BF16 2.5 PF dense / 5.0 PF sparse; MXFP8 5.0 PF dense / 10 PF sparse; FP6/FP4 10 PF dense; FP64 78.6 TF. matrix_unit [16,16,32] = CDNA4 v_mfma_*_16x16x32 BF16/FP16 tile (K doubled vs CDNA3); representative shape -> SILVER (CDNA4 also has 32x32x64 and scaled FP8 variants). dtype_bytes=2 for the BF16 path this peak_macs_per_s describes.

provenance.source: device peaks GOLD (AMD MI355X datasheet/whitepaper); per-instance MAC derived from GOLD device peak / 256 CU (SILVER); matrix_unit representative CDNA4 MFMA shape (SILVER, ROCm matrix-cores-cdna blog)

meta.variant_note: MI350X = 2.2 GHz/1000 W bin (~2.3 PF BF16); this twin = MI355X 2.4 GHz/1400 W bin
